Prayer : Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of  praying for issuance of Writ of Mandamus directing the 2nd respondent / 
 District Collector (Revenue) to consider the Petitioners Representation  01.02.2019, 07.04.2025, 12.06.2025 & 07.11.2025 to re-determine the  compensation awarded to the petitioner for her lands in R.S.No.24/11  measuring an extent of 0.09.50 ares acquired at Karasur Revenue village   Award No.2/2008 to a sum of Rs.21,261 / - per Are, pursuant to the enhan  compensation award dated 01.12.2018 passed in LAOP No.110 of 2012 on the  file of II Additional District Judge, Puducherry.
For Petitioner: Ms. D.E.Anisree Sangavi
For Respondents: Mr.V.Vasanthakumar, Addl. G  ORDER
The petitioners land was acquired under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
Compensation in respect thereof was received by the petitioner.
Meanwhile, the petitioner came to know that enhanced compensation was paid in respect of lands covered under the same notification pursuant to order in L.A.O.P.No.110 of 2012.
After submitting an application under Section 28A of the enactment, the present writ petition has been filed.

_ Page2 of 4 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 03/02/2026 06:47:35 pm )
2.
Mr.V.Vasanthakumar, learned Additional Government Pleader, accepts notice for the respondents.
By handing over written instructions, he submits that necessary funds have been requested for from the requisitioning department for purposes of disbursing enhanced compensation.
Within a reasonable time from the receipt thereof, he submits that the enhanced compensation would be disbursed to the petitioner.

3. By recording the above submissions, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the second respondent to take necessary measures for the disbursement of enhanced compensation to the petitioner in terms of Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as expeditiously as possible,
preferably
within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order
